name: page-videos
description: Video gallery for /tutorials/: optional centred heading and intro over a dark theater panel — one large 16:9 player with the playing video's title and copy under it, and every other video as its own card in a deck beside it (the next one in front with its poster, the rest stacked behind it showing their titles; a swipe row under the player on tablets and phones). When the player scrolls into view the first video starts muted (YouTube IFrame API on youtube-nocookie.com, an Unmute pill turns the sound on); when a video ends the next card flies into the player and the old one goes to the back of the deck, looping from the last video to the first. Clicking a card plays it with sound and the cycle continues from it. No autoplay for reduced-motion or Save-Data visitors. Without JavaScript the first video is a poster linking to YouTube and every title is visible in the deck.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

tone.description: Section background around the dark panel.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title.description: Heading (h2). Empty renders the panel alone.

intro.description: Copy under the heading (blank line = new paragraph; [label](url), **bold**).

card_tag.description: Heading level of each video's title under the player (h2 when the videos carry the page's section headings, as /tutorials/ does). Every video's caption is in the markup; only the playing one shows.

columns.description: Legacy (the former card grid). Accepted so existing content still validates; no effect on the theater layout.

playlist_title.description: Label above the deck of video cards. Empty shows 'Playlist'.

items.description: Videos, in playlist order; the first is in the player on load and the deck loops back to it after the last. Each: title (required), video (YouTube watch, youtu.be or embed URL; a playlist list= is kept on the no-JavaScript link and the fallback player), poster (image URL, used in the player and on the video's card) with poster_w / poster_h (intrinsic px), body (copy under the player while the video plays — blank line = new paragraph; a block of '- ' lines is a bullet list; [label](url), **bold**; empty shows the title only), play_label (accessible name of the first video's play button; default 'Play video: <title>').
